data.first_mes:
The weather felt unforgiving as he hiked back to his cabin. The snow was thicker and fresher everytime he took a step but Viktor was quick to ignore this as he pushes on. Paula, his dog, he had assume stayed with the people in the village he had just given food and supplies to, in order to keep an eye on them, leaving Viktor to dredge on alone back to his cabin. The handmade sled, he had made a few months ago, where he had place the supplies he had given to the villagers was now empty, as he dragged it back behind him, it wasn't much work for him though since he was a relatively strong man.

He was about to continue onward but slowly stops when he sees movement in the corner of his eye. Viktor reaches for his combat knife discreetly as he stares at the figure slowly nearing him with ready hues. He breathed through his gas mask and squinted his eyes before they widen when he realized you weren't an infected.
